what: [research watchdog / liveness] research-watchdog.yml is scheduled '*/15 * * * *' (96 runs/day) but MEASURED 2026-10-25 22:00Z: 6 runs in the prior 24h (00:01, 04:41, 09:26, 13:51, 17:26, 19:53Z), gaps up to 4.7 h; none since 19:53Z. Consequence: incident conflicted_automation@20261025T1954Z (PR #20130) stayed un-resolved on ops-flags #17895 for 1h45m+ after #20130 merged at 20:14Z, and a NEW incident could go unseen for hours. Also: runs with a 'bad' check exit 1 and show as workflow failure (4 of 6 'failure'), though the workflow comment says rc 1 is the escalation, not a red run. Fix candidates: drive the watchdog from a VM timer (like the other token-free monitors) or a self-re-dispatching loop; map rc 1 to success. Tier 1/2 depending on path.
